title: helianthemum montanum subsp. italicum
intro: Helianthemum montanum subsp. italicum, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a perennial plant species within the Cistaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include its ability to act as a vulnerary, astringent, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for wound healing and skin protection. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
